prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remained biased: high positive forecasts consistently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts frequently underpredicted major wins.
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-16.0% and -9.1%).
Choose path copy changes (choose_path, copy) performed worse in 2 out of 3 tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) yielded inconsistent results, each driving significant wins (+4.9% to +6.7%) alongside clear losses (-4.5% to -9.6%).
Evidence remains thin for categories lacking at least 2 agreeing tests (such as choose_path layout, finish layout, and single-test changes).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Grid Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step into a compact grid layout to reduce scrolling and friction during pet adoption. (why: Adoption drop-off is 23.4% with a median duration of 89s, indicating users spend significant effort comparing options.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Accessories Sub-Flow: Add a pet accessory selection step right after picking a pet to increase emotional attachment before final adoption. (why: Adoption stage takes a median 89s and support emails indicate high user demand for pet customization options.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Screen Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout showcasing animated pet companions alongside authentication options. (why: Sign-in conversion is 79.7% with a mean duration of 567s, reflecting user hesitation during authentication.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Personality Quiz Screen: Insert a personality quiz screen prior to choose_path to help guide users to their preferred companion type. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s with 13.8% drop-off; guiding decision-making reduces choice paralysis.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Card Carousel Redesign: Redesign the initial story intro screen into an interactive card carousel showcasing desktop pet features. (why: Story and path selection average 514s mean time, demonstrating a need for engaging introductory visual structure.)
5: [finish, layout] Home Intro Full Bleed Layout: Change the final home intro layout to a full bleed presentation showcasing the desktop pet arrival. (why: Finish stage has the lowest funnel conversion at 68.0% and a high mean completion time.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add a prominent companion owner milestone badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption drop-off is 23.4%; offering positive reinforcement upon adoption boosts transition to waiting screen.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desk Docking Visual: Add an animation component to the waiting screen illustrating how the pet docks on the user's desktop screen. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how or where the pet appears on their desktop display.)
8: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint: Add a explicit hint on the final home intro screen explaining system tray controls for managing the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to control, hide, or chat with the pet.)
